key_findings: Endoglin is reduced in serum of PHN patients and in spinal cord of SNI rats; recombinant endoglin relieved hyperalgesia, microglial activation, inflammation and BSCB disruption.
Endoglin protects the BSCB via TGF-beta/Smad2 signaling, as Smad2 knockdown abolished its protective effects.
